jobs_results.title: Desarrollador backend senior node js
jobs_results.description:
¿Quieres formar parte del #TeamPanel? Buscamos ampliar equipo para uno de los proyectos en los que estamos trabajando, integrados en uno de nuestros grandes clientes.

Requisitos de la oferta...
• Desarrollador senior de backend con amplia experiencia en Node.js, Javascript, Typecript, npm, Express/Fastify, Redis, API REST, microservicios, Docker, Visual Studio Code
• Otros conocimientos muy valorables: Arquitectura Clean/Hexagonal/Orientada a Eventos, metodologías Ágiles, Jira, Git
• Openshift/Kubernetes, GraphQL, Lua, NGINX, Kafka, Couchbase
• Inglés (nivel escrito alto)
• Proactividad, capacidad de trabajo en equipo, capacidad para comunicador ideas y conocimiento, experiencia en equipos medios/grandes y multi-disciplinares.
• INGLES: ALTO (B2)

¿De qué estarás a cargo?
Formarás parte de uno de nuestros equipo de Desarrollo integrado en cliente, realizando las siguientes funciones:
• Desarrollo, arquitectura e ingeniería para la implementación del roadmap de la plataforma de video... entre las que destacan:
• Diseño de la arquitectura software y de despliegue de los componentes de TV Open Platform para soportar las funcionalidades requeridas
• Implementación de la funcionalidad requerida
• Soporte a las actividades de ingeniería en los datacenters (productivos y no productivos) de la solución de TV Open Platform
• Dimensionado y escalabilidad de la solución
• Despliegue de las nuevas versiones asociadas a la plataforma TV Open Platform en todos los entornos
• Apoyo a las tareas de troubleshooting relacionadas con el entorno de preproducción y producción
• Gestión técnica del de despliegue de nuevas funcionalidades y bufixing; activación y verificación del correcto funcionamiento de las nuevas funcionalidades asociadas a los nuevos desarrollos
• Documentación de las nuevas funcionalidades

Lugar de Trabajo:
HIBRIDO (3 dias presenciales en Madrid / 2 días en teletrabajo).

¿Qué ofrecemos?
-Impulsaremos tu Talento con un Plan de Desarrollo Profesional y Programas de Tutoría individualizada.
-Completo Programa de formación que incluye desde programas de especialización técnica hasta idiomas, habilidades en gestión de proyectos, metodologías ágiles y certificaciones. Tanto on-line como presencial.
-Políticas de conciliación como el Teletrabajo en modo full-remote; jornada continua los viernes y en verano, flexibilidad horaria, días de permiso en navidad, y facilidades para la movilidad geográfica de los empleados.
-Beneficios sociales como retribución flexible, complemento al 100% de bajas médicas, condiciones especiales en seguro médico privado o Tarjeta VISA empleados.

Nuestra empresa es hoy referencia en el sector del Software Quality Assurance, participando en varios proyectos de investigación a nivel europeo, y con muchos más proyectos sobre los que podrás diseñar una trayectoria profesional a largo plazo. Aplica y nos conoceremos

jobs_results.title: Back End Developer
jobs_results.description:
Resumen del puesto
• Cliente final líder a nivel internacional en su sector, busca incorporar un perfil de SR Backend Developer (5-10 años de experiencia) con sólida experiencia en C#, SQL, Arquitectura y API REST.

Descripción del puesto de trabajo
• Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener aplicaciones backend utilizando C# para integraciones con nuestro ERP.
• Colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios para comprender los requisitos del negocio y diseñar soluciones técnicas eficientes.
• Desarrollar y optimizar consultas SQL para la manipulación de datos en la base de datos del ERP.
• Implementar y mantener servicios RESTful para la comunicación entre diferentes sistemas.
• Implementar Arquitecturas de Eventos para mejorar la escalabilidad y la capacidad de respuesta del sistema.
• Realizar pruebas unitarias y de integración para garantizar la calidad del código y la estabilidad del sistema.
• Investigar y evaluar nuevas tecnologías y herramientas que puedan mejorar el rendimiento y la... eficiencia de las integraciones del ERP.

Perfil buscado (H/M/D)
• Experiencia sólida en desarrollo backend utilizando C#.
• Conocimiento profundo de SQL y experiencia en el diseño y optimización de consultas.
• Experiencia en el diseño e implementación de Arquitecturas de Eventos.
• Familiaridad con el diseño y desarrollo de REST API.
• Capacidad para trabajar de manera colaborativa en un entorno de equipo.
• Habilidad para comunicarse efectivamente con stakeholders técnicos y no técnicos.
• Excelentes habilidades de resolución de problemas y atención al detalle.
• Diploma universitario en Informática, Ingeniería de Software o un campo relacionado (o experiencia equivalente).
• Experiencia previa en el desarrollo e integración de sistemas ERP.
• Conocimiento de patrones de diseño de software y principios de desarrollo ágil.
• Familiaridad con tecnologías relacionadas como ASP.NET, Entity Framework, etc.

Características del puesto

Modelo de Trabajo Presencial en Valencia

Banda salarial hasta 45K

jobs_results.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs_results.description:
If you’re interested, send us an email at careers and tell us why you want to join us. We'll get back to you fast!
About us Mission

At Evy, we strive to transform the insurance and services industry for the better. Our mission is simple: create the best product protection & repair experience ever, and help merchants offer it to their customers.
Team

We're a tight-knit team of 20+ talented people founded by cofounders with diverse backgrounds:
Simon (ex-McKinsey) is our CEO, Shana (ex-Apple) our CTO, Tanguy (ex-Qonto) our CPO, and Benjamin (ex-Oney) our CBO.
Product

Our product takes several forms. For merchants, we've built an API-first solution that lets them offer product insurance and services to their customers, as well as a dashboard to monitor key metrics. For customers, we've designed a simple (and fast ️) claims experience.
Tech & Insurance expertise

Tech - Our APIs are built to handle billions of requests while ensuring a very low response time. Providing a highly... performant, stable API is mission critical to our integration in leading marketplaces and retailer platforms.

Insurance - Being able to adapt to different geographies, regulations, and customer needs is critical to the success of our partnerships. Remaining on top of all these topics while keeping our speed and agility is key.
Funding

We have raised several million dollars from some of the best VCs and angels in the world, including US-based Sequoia Capital.
Remote Friendly

Our headquarters are located in Paris but we offer both full and flexible remote opportunities. We are looking for candidates in the CET timezone ± 2 hours (Paris, London, Madrid, Berlin, ...). This position is for a full-time employment.
What is the role?

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our team. You will be responsible adding to our ever growing suite of features and APIs, and executing our ambitious roadmap. You’d be joining a team of highly talented engineers with experience from some of the best companies such as Algolia, Apple or Datadog and top schools such as Polytechnique and Centrale.
What

you'll do

Design, build, and maintain APIs, services, and systems across our engineering team. You will be developing and scaling these from the ground up. Your design decisions will be the building blocks of our technical stack and have a lasting impact.

Own critical parts of the product and work self-directed. We're a small team of individual contributors, everybody has autonomy and responsibility.

Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization, including our Product team.

Contribute to hiring your future coworkers and improve our candidate experience.
You may be a good fit if

You've written high quality code in object oriented languages in the past. While experience in Go is a plus, we care more about your general engineering skillset than knowledge of a specific language.

You have 5+ years experience designing and implementing highly scalable and reliable REST APIs.

You are fluent in English (no need to speak French!).

Backend — Go:
Providing best-in-class APIs to our eCommerce customers.

Frontend — React, Type Script:
Creating a beautiful user interface. We iterate on designs and don’t compromise until we have a great product.

Operations — GCP:
Maintaining a stable, secure fleet of servers.

Tools — Linear for issue tracking, Github as source control, Postman for API development, Slack for internal communication, and many others.
Perks and benefits Health and wellbeing

We offer comprehensive health insurance with Axa.

We let you organize your time off as you see fit.

We offer both full remote and flexible remote opportunities. Our headquarters are in Paris, France.

We let you choose a laptop, monitor, and any other tool you need to feel comfortable.

You’ll have a stake in the company you’re building.

Pluriannual team gatherings in delightful places.
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Senior Node.js Backend Developer
jobs_results.description:
Senior Node.js Backend Developer

Company Overview:

A-SAFE DIGITAL is a dynamic and innovative tech company dedicated to providing digital solutions for the A-SAFE Group. We are seeking a talented and experienced Senior Node.js Backend Developer to join our growing team. As a hybrid workplace, we offer a collaborative environment where you can work remotely for a portion of the week and spend 2 days in our office.

Position Overview:

As a Senior Node.js Backend Developer, you will be a key player in architecting, implementing, and maintaining robust and scalable server-side applications. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-performance solutions that power our web applications and services.

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, and maintain scalable and efficient backend services using Node.js.
• Collaborate with front-end developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to deliver integrated solutions.
• Implement and maintain database structures and... optimize queries for performance.
• Work with modern frameworks and tools, ensuring code quality and adherence to best practices.
• Conduct code reviews to ensure high standards of coding and mentor junior team members.
• Implement and maintain RESTful APIs and other communication protocols.
• Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies to propose innovative solutions.

Qualifications:
• Minimum of 5 years of professional experience as a Node.js Backend Developer with a proven track record.
• Strong proficiency in Node.js and asynchronous programming.
• Experience with popular Node.js frameworks such as Express.
• Proficiency in designing and optimizing database schemas (e.g., MongoDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL).
• Knowledge of containerization technologies (Docker) and orchestration tools (Kubernetes).
• Familiarity with microservices architecture and serverless computing.
• Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines and version control systems.
• Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
• Ability to thrive in a collaborative and fast-paced work environment.

Benefits:

- Flexible work schedule with 2 days in the office and the option for remote work.

- Professional development opportunities.

- Vibrant company culture with team-building activities and events.

We look forward to welcoming a new member to our team who shares our commitment to excellence and innovation in backend development

jobs_results.title: Backend Developer
jobs_results.description:
Java developer Job Offer We are looking for a Java developer to join our software development team ! We build goal-driven working software and we want essential people to be part of our growing team and to work with us on inspiring projects.

Who we are?

At Apiumhub, we are experts in software architecture and software development. We build scalable software platforms and think about performance and cost reduction every time we start the project. We receive interesting projects from around the world, as startups projects as projects for big international companies. But what we always do the same – we build working software. And we want like-minded people to join us!

Meet our growing family!

What are the requirements?

Qualifications:

Bachelor Degree in computer science, software engineering or similar5+ years of backend development experience

Experience in Java Experience in Spring Boot Experience in Continuous Integration

Experience working with Docker

Experience with... DDDDevOps knowledge

Agile Methodologies Experience in Test Driven Development and unit testing

Strong knowledge of SOLID principles

Strong knowledge in object-oriented programming concepts (polymorphism, interface segregation, encapsulation, topology, etc)
Understanding of refactoring concepts

Knowledge of the main and the most used design patterns

Be experienced in working on Linux Fluent speaking Spanish Desired skills:

Experience in Kotlin Know how to work with CI & TDD Functional coding experience

Experience with gRPCFluent in English

Responsibilities Opportunity to work on various types of projects from different industries (possibility to work remotely 100%)Team empowerment

Apply best practices in software development

Work with strict Agile methodologies

Work with TDD & CIDo refactoring to a DDD architecture

Learn more about Software Architecture and Dev Ops Develop complex software projects with an eye on performance, scalability, and reusability

Benefits

Permanent contract and 23 days of vacation.

Remote friendly policy, be the owner of your time and enjoy the flexibility and remote working. We have an amazing new office in the Barcelona center (with free snacks, coffee and beer), and we will be very happy to share moments with you there whenever you want.

Medical insurance with dental coverage.

Free English classes.

Personal budget for continuous learning, training and certifications.

Team budget just for fun.

You will enjoy different activities, from technical and informal workshops to off site company events.

Last but not least, join a growing family with a great sense of humor and healthy environment.

Process
30-40minuts introduction meeting to talk about what we can offer you, and know a little bit about you, your experience and your goals.
1h technical meeting. No-code meeting, just technical discussions.
30 minutes cultural fit meeting.

At Apiumhub we value profiles without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status or any other ground or circumstances protected by federal, state or local law

jobs_results.title: [WMJ-012] - Backend Developer
jobs_results.description:
Estamos en busca de un Desarrollador Backend entusiasta y altamente habilidoso para unirse a nuestra agencia de marketing digital innovadora y de ritmo rápido. Como miembro clave de nuestro equipo de desarrollo, trabajarás estrechamente con nuestros desarrolladores para diseñar, desarrollar y mantener sistemas backend que potencien los sitios y aplicaciones de nuestros clientes.El candidato ideal tiene un entendimiento sólido de los conceptos de desarrollo backend, incluyendo APIs RESTful, diseño de bases de datos y programación del lado del servidor utilizando lenguajes de programación y frameworks relevantes. Estamos buscando a alguien que disfrute colaborando con un equipo de desarrolladores frontend y backend,que quiera sumergirse en algo de código y diseñar sitios innovadores y revolucionarios......We are seeking an enthusiastic and highly skilled Backend Developer to join our fast-paced and innovative digital marketing agency. As a key member of our dev team, you will work... closely with our developer team to design, develop, and maintain backend systems that power the sites and applications of our clients.The ideal candidate has an understanding of backend development concepts, including RESTful APIs, database design, and server-side programming using relevant programming languages and frameworks. We are looking for someone who enjoys collaborating with a team of frontend and backend developers, wants to get their hands dirty in some code, and design cool ground-breaking sites.What You'll Do Collaborate closely with the Director of Technology and Backend Lead to address technical challenges across diverse projects, spanning analysis, timeline management, execution, and deployment of various technologies.Implement efficient data storage solutions and optimize database performance.Write clean,modular, and maintainable code following best practices and coding standards.Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, consistency, and adherence to coding standards.Troubleshoot and debug issues, identify bottlenecks, and implement solutions to ensure smooth operation of backend systems.Stay updated on emerging technologies and industry trends, and propose innovative solutions to improve system architecture and performance.Collaborate with frontend developers to integrate frontend components with backend services.Contribute to the design and architecture of new features and enhancements.Who You Are At least one year of experience in backend development or a similar role and/or a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.Proficient in diverse programming languages, including PHP and JavaScript,along with prominent JavaScript frameworks like React.Js, Vue, and Astro.Strong understanding of backend development concepts, including RESTful APIs, database design, and server-side programming.Familiarity with relational and non-relational databases (e.G., MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB)
